proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x₀ y₀ x y h h0
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr h
  constructor
  · intro h3
    refine ⟨u * (y₀ - y) + v * (x - x₀), ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination (-(x - x₀)) * huv + u * (h3 - h0)
    · linear_combination (y₀ - y) * huv + v * (h3 - h0)
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩
    linear_combination h0
target_source: ∀ (a b c x₀ y₀ x y : ℤ), Int.gcd a b = 1 → a * x₀ + b * y₀ = c → (a * x + b * y = c ↔ ∃ t : ℤ, x = x₀ + b * t ∧ y = y₀ - a * t)
